coach_summary: 16 of 24 throws scored (8 in the hole, 8 on the board); 8 missed. Release angle was more spread out on misses (SD 6 vs 2°). Sideways aim (heading) was more spread out on misses (SD 2.1 vs 1.1°). Keep recording. The least repeatable measured variable was release angle (SD 4°); watch it in the next session. Reviewed release-to-first-contact time: 1.02 s. Across 24 comparable throws: typical throw-to-throw spread (RMS pointwise SD) of each curve. Smaller means more repeatable; it does not rate technique quality.

consistency.equation: Waveform variability = RMS over the cycle of the pointwise sample SD; wrist uses sqrt(mean(SDx² + SDy²)); release timing uses the sample SD of the release fraction.
consistency.message: Across 24 comparable throws: typical throw-to-throw spread (RMS pointwise SD) of each curve. Smaller means more repeatable; it does not rate technique quality.

outcome.notes: Recorded automatically from the front camera; check the video and change it if it is wrong.
outcome.precision_note: Landing points were measured on the board camera through a four-corner deck homography; see the view's inches-per-pixel conditioning for their precision.

final_rest.note: Visible board-plane points only; excludes unlocated misses. Grouping is not target accuracy.

first_contact.note: Visible board-plane points only; excludes unlocated misses. Grouping is not target accuracy.

sports.definition: PPR = 4 × mean points per bag (gross, no cancellation), as reported by the American Cornhole League.

feedback.caveat: Based on 24 throws from this athlete. These are associations, not proven causes; differences smaller than measurement uncertainty are not reported.
feedback.next: Keep recording. The least repeatable measured variable was release angle (SD 4°); watch it in the next session.
feedback.physics: Physics check (drag-free model): release speed varies by 0.43 m/s (SD) but the hole window is only ±0.24 m/s wide.
feedback.result: 16 of 24 throws scored (8 in the hole, 8 on the board); 8 missed.
feedback.why: Release angle was more spread out on misses (SD 6 vs 2°). Sideways aim (heading) was more spread out on misses (SD 2.1 vs 1.1°).

summary.method: Cliff's delta for a shift in each variable and for misses lying further from the scored-throw median; claimed only with ≥ 5 throws per group, |δ| above both 0.474 (large) and the chance level for this sample size (Bonferroni across all variables tested), and a difference above the noise floor. Stress-tested on simulated athletes (docs/STRESS_TEST.md).

zones.meaning: Green/yellow/red = where a drag-free bag with these release values first lands: hole window / elsewhere on the board / off. Model zones, checked against observed outcomes.

quality.confidence_note: Model confidence is not a calibrated physical position or angle error.

calibration.note: A gravity scale assumes the flight plane is square to the camera; it is not a 3D calibration.

rules.bag: GOOD: bag found in ≥90% of flight frames, no gap longer than 3 frames, ≤10% of samples rejected as outliers, measurement noise σ ≤ 2 px. WARNING: ≥70% coverage and no gap longer than 6 frames. Otherwise POOR. No tracked flight is POOR.
rules.calibration: GOOD: an independent in-plane scale agrees with the flight's gravity scale within 10%. WARNING: a single scale source (gravity-only or measured-only). POOR: no physical scale (results stay in pixels / arm lengths).
rules.pose: GOOD: required landmarks usable in ≥90% of frames and ≥90% of frames within ±50 ms of release. WARNING: ≥70% and ≥60%. Otherwise POOR.
rules.release: GOOD: release confirmed by a person, or found automatically with the two release cues (first free-flight frame; backward flight meets the wrist) within 4 frames (67 ms at 60 fps), ≥6 launch-fit samples and launch-angle SE ≤ 3°. WARNING: automatic release with a window of 5–6 frames, failing a fit check, or whose in-hand check could not run (no wrist) or was capped by the minimum detection count. POOR: no confirmed release, or cues more than 6 frames apart.

body_release.sentence: Throws with higher peak elbow extension velocity were associated with higher release speed (ρ = 0.60, 99.0% CI 0.15 to 0.84).
No clear association between peak shoulder angular velocity and release speed (ρ = 0.28).
No clear association between shoulder angle at release and release angle (ρ = 0.07).
No clear association between elbow angle at release and release angle (ρ = -0.11).

body_release.caveat: Near-tautological: the bag is in the hand at release, so this mostly reflects measurement geometry rather than an independent movement finding.
body_release.sentence: Throws with higher hand speed at release were associated with higher release speed (ρ = 0.62, 99.0% CI 0.13 to 0.90).

coordination.method: Point-wise SD of the shoulder–elbow angle–angle curve over the time-normalised forward swing.

error_budget.method: predicted_sd_in: SD across throws of each throw's own release speed/angle/height/distance run through the drag-free model (Venkadesan & Mahadevan 2017). predicted_sd_cov_in: linearised check, sqrt(J Sigma J^T) with the empirical release covariance. independent_sd_in: the same Jacobian assuming speed/angle/height vary independently (ignores observed covariation); covariance_shares can be negative when a pair's covariation reduces landing spread.
error_budget.sentence: If speed, angle and height varied independently, speed variation would account for about 90% of the model's landing spread.

outcome.label: release speed
outcome.rho_abs_landing_error_sentence: Higher release speed was associated with smaller landing error (ρ = -0.55, 99.3% CI -0.82 to -0.05).

outcome.label: energy match
outcome.rho_abs_landing_error_sentence: Higher energy match was associated with smaller landing error (ρ = -0.60, 99.3% CI -0.86 to -0.13).

predicted_vs_measured.r_squared_note: Pearson r^2 (squared correlation), not 1 - SSE/SST; the two coincide only when the predictions are an unbiased linear fit to the measured values.
predicted_vs_measured.sentence: Release conditions explain 44% of the measured landing variation; the remainder is attributed to (not separated here) bag slide, air drag and measurement error.

speed_angle_tradeoff.sentence: No clear speed-angle trade-off (the Theil-Sen slope's 95% CI includes 0).

verdict.headline: On the board: 1 point. It landed 16 in short of the hole and slid 22 in, stopping 7 in past the hole.

items.text: The bag ended 7 in past the hole. At the same angle, about 0.04 m/s slower would have carried it to the hole (if it slides the same way).
Unusual for this athlete: longer backswing relative to the forward swing (3.2 back ÷ forward; usual 1.7–1.8 back ÷ forward).
Unusual for this athlete: faster peak hand speed (11.0 arm lengths/s; usual 10.1–10.6 arm lengths/s).
Within the usual range: elbow angle at release, trunk lean at release.

verdict.method: Drag-free point-mass flight to first contact (zones.landing); personal flags when |value − median| > max(noise floor, 1.5·IQR/1.349) with ≥ 5 other throws.
